lead.t: Renal involvement: “Any recent swelling of legs, reduced urine output, blood in urine, sudden rise in blood pressure?” — Scleroderma renal crisis (SRC) is an emergency; early hypertension or proteinuria is a red flag.

snip.t: Renal involvement: “Any recent swelling of legs, reduced urine output, blood in urine, sudden rise in blood pressure?” — Scleroderma renal crisis (SRC) is an emergency; early hypertension or proteinuria is a red flag.
Kidneys (glomeruli & arterioles): Vascular injury → scleroderma renal crisis

qs.q: Which medication class is highlighted for its prompt use to control blood pressure and improve prognosis in scleroderma renal crisis?
qs.e: Prompt use of ACE inhibitors to control blood pressure before renal failure occurs is vital for improving the prognosis of scleroderma renal crisis. Other antihypertensive classes do not carry the same specific renal-protective emphasis in this setting.
